sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def bb(fr):
    out={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','M','c','N'):
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            out[n['color']]= (min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs))
    return out
r = action(['RIGHT','RIGHT','RIGHT'])
print('ceiling-right2:', bb(last_transition.before_frame), '->', bb(last_transition.after_frame), {k: last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','game_over','level_completed')})
r = action(['DOWN']*8)
print('floor-right:', bb(last_transition.before_frame), '->', bb(last_transition.after_frame), {k: last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','game_over','level_completed')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
